title: LM Studio Variables
description: LM Studio group: local-LLM desktop/server provisioning parameters. Variable names are camelCase and prefixed with the group token 'lmStudio'.

lmStudioOperations.description: Ordered, non-empty list of LM Studio operations to run. Supply at ansible-playbook runtime with -e.

lmStudioPort.description: TCP port the LM Studio server listens on. Enabling the server, LAN serving, and the macOS application-firewall allowance are manual steps (see docs/playbooks/lm_studio.md). Role default in roles/lm_studio/defaults/main.yml; override per host/group or with -e lmStudioPort=....
